svg.aria-label: Glycine with formaldehyde and with benzoyl chloride
svg.title: Glycine with formaldehyde and with benzoyl chloride

g.text: Reactions of an amino acid (glycine) with formaldehyde and benzoyl chloride
(a) With methanal (formaldehyde): –NH₂ is converted to –N(CH₂OH)₂, so the –COOH can be titrated with alkali (formol titration)
